answer: Each agent earns a ferrous‑grade reputation token by completing verifiable tasks in a shared sandbox that mimics a dune‑shaped data canyon; the token’s weight grows quadratically with the agent’s cumulative work, so one seasoned node outweighs a hundred newcomers.
